run_dojo_experiment: run a dojo experiment using hydra config to execute a solver on a task
build_task_from_config: build a task instance from the run config using TASK_MAP and the build utility
build_solver_from_config: build a solver instance from the run config using SOLVER_MAP and task info
build_interpreter_from_config: build a solver interpreter from the run config using INTERPRETER_MAP and data directory
review_main_entry_point: review the main entry point that validates hydra config and delegates to _main
